class: Resume dispatched to video-only file input
symptom: A PDF was assigned to Upload Video accepting video/*; the page said Invalid media type but the agent logged ATTACHED.
root_cause: The first file input was selected without checking accepted types or document purpose, and explicit rejection was ignored.
why_tests_missed: The live portal variant was not represented in regression fixtures.
fix: Choose a compatible resume or generic document slot, exclude other document purposes, and refuse success on explicit upload errors. Both the browser helper and inventory uploader use centralized file-type and rejection checks.
prevention: Retain synthetic coverage for the observed portal contract and preserve neighboring working behavior.
